sfr_candidates.description_raw: Email was received: Dear Louisville Metro311 / Code Enforcement, I am submitting this as an addendum to my previous complaints regarding the severely overgrown property directly behind my home at 6415 Tradesmill Drive, Louisville, KY 40291. This has been an ongoing problem for several years, and it has been reported to the city by both phone and email in the past. Several years ago, after previous complaints, the property was cleaned up one time, but it was not maintained and the overgrowth has returned. Trees, vines, brush, and other vegetation from this property are growing over, through, and against my privately owned fence. The vegetation is putting pressure on the fence and causing it to bend. Dense brush and vegetation remaining against the wood can also trap moisture and contribute to deterioration and rot. The overgrowth has interfered with access around my fence and gate as well. There is also a large mature tree immediately outside our fence that has continued to grow without apparent maintenance, with large limbs extending over the adjoining yards and toward our homes. Because of its size and proximity to the residences, I am requesting that the tree also be inspected to determine whether it presents a safety or property-damage hazard. I am attaching a photograph showing the current condition and the proximity of the large tree to the fence and surrounding homes. The property owner is associated with 8200 Ferndale Road, Louisville, KY. Because this is a recurring problem that has already been reported multiple times over a period of years, I am asking Louisville Metro Code Enforcement to inspect the property and take whatever enforcement action is necessary to require the owner to clear the overgrowth and properly maintain the property going forward. Please provide me with the service request or case number for this complaint and let me know what action will be taken. I would also appreciate confirmation once the property has been inspected. Thank you for your attention to this ongoing issue.
inspector_comments: Please cut back overgrowth growing into and causing damage to fence line running from 6409 to 6419 TradesMill Dr.
Roof and gutter components must be properly installed and kept in good repair, functioning as intended. Clean out gutters where needed. Repair or replace downturned gutter on right side of house.
Remove dead tree, cut to the stump, located behind 6415 tradesmill rd

recent_window_descriptions: R01 - RENTAL REGISTRATION - RES. [119-LMCO] The failure to register a rental housing unit or apartment complex in accordance with LMCO 119.03 shall be classified as a civil offense with a penalty of up to $100 per rental housing unit or apartment complex. The owner or managing operator will be sent a ten day notice of violation with a warning of the failure to comply with the rental registry. Failure to comply at the end of ten days will result in a fine of up to $100 per rental housing unit or apartment complex. Thereafter, each day of such violation(s) shall constitute a separate offense.
